proof_body:
by
  intro Ω E _ _ P _ X A hX hI hA
  have hle : ∀ n, MeasurableSpace.comap (X n) inferInstance ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Ω) := fun n => (hX n).comap_le
  refine ProbabilityTheory.measure_zero_or_one_of_measurableSet_limsup_atTop hle (((ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_iff_iIndep _ _ _).mp hI)) ?_
  rwa [Filter.limsup_eq_iInf_iSup_of_nat]
target_source: ∀ (Ω E : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace E] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : ℕ → Ω → E) (A : Set Ω), (∀ n, Measurable (X n)) → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P → @MeasurableSet Ω (⨅ n, ⨆ k ≥ n, MeasurableSpace.comap (X k) inferInstance) A → P A = 0 ∨ P A = 1
